description: Creates a styled QR code for a link, text, email address or phone number and returns the image, a print-size PNG link and a link to edit it in the LNX QR studio. Choose a style and an optional frame with a short call to action (e.g. "SCAN FOR MENU").

background.description: Optional hex background color, e.g. #ffffff. Must be light.

color.description: Optional hex color for the code itself, e.g. #1e3a8a; overrides the style's colors. Must be dark.

content.description: What the code opens: a URL, a text, an email address or a phone number (max 900 characters).

content_type.description: url (default), text, email (opens a new email) or phone (starts a call).

frame.description: Frame around the code. none (default) or outline have no text; label-bottom, label-top, button, solid-card, ticket, tag, bubble, banner, arrow, corners, minimal, phone, double show frame_text.

frame_text.description: Call to action shown in the frame, max 24 characters, e.g. "SCAN ME", "SCAN FOR MENU".

style.description: Design. classic = plain black squares; rounded / dots = soft black shapes; violet, peach, forest, sunset = color gradients; sand, sky, rose, mint = single brand-like colors; ink-dots = black dots.

name: create_qr_code
title: Create a QR code
